description: This file defines a React component called ChartsSection, which displays trend charts for coverage and freshness metrics using embedded Sparkline components. It includes helper functions for data normalization and SVG path building, and references types CoveragePoint and FreshnessPoint.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Normalizes a number 'n' to the range between 'min' and 'max'.

methods.name: buildPolyline
methods.description: Constructs a polyline string from a list of points for SVG rendering.
